Let me create a comprehensive CAM setup script that:
1. Opens the precondition file
2. Creates a stock block that fully contains the part
3. Sets up a CAM job with appropriate toolpaths

{"script": "cat > /tmp/cam_setup.py << 'ENDSCRIPT'
import FreeCAD
import Part
import math

# Open the precondition file
doc = FreeCAD.open("/home/user/Precondition_Unnamed.FCStd")
print("Document opened:", doc.Name)

# Get the body shape for reference
body = doc.getObject("Body")
shape = body.Shape

# Calculate bounding box of the part
bbox = shape.BoundBox
print(f"Part bounding box: ({bbox.XMin}, {bbox.YMin}, {bbox.ZMin}) to ({bbox.XMax}, {bbox.YMax}, {bbox.ZMax})")

# Create a stock block that fully contains the part with some margin
# Add 10mm margin on each side
margin = 10
stock_x_min = bbox.XMin - margin
stock_y_min = bbox.YMin - margin
stock_z_min = bbox.ZMin - margin
stock_x_max = bbox.XMax + margin
stock_y_max = bbox.YMax + margin
stock_z_max = bbox.ZMax + margin

stock_width = stock_x_max - stock_x_min
stock_depth = stock_y_max - stock_y_min
stock_height = stock_z_max - stock_z_min

print(f"Stock dimensions: {stock_width:.2f} x {stock_depth:.2f} x {stock_height:.2f}")
print(f"Stock position: ({stock_x_min}, {stock_y_min}, {stock_z_min}) to ({stock_x_max}, {stock_y_max}, {stock_z_max})")

# Create stock as a PartDesign Body
stock_body = doc.addObject("PartDesign::Body", "Stock")
print(f"Created Stock body: {stock_body.Name}")

# Create the stock box feature
box_feature = doc.addObject("PartDesign::Box", "StockBox")
box_feature.Label = "Stock Material"
box_feature.Length = stock_width  # X direction
box_feature.Width = stock_depth   # Y direction  
box_feature.Height = stock_height # Z direction

# Position the stock box
# We need to place it so it encompasses the part
# The box is created at origin, we need to offset it
placement = box_feature.Placement
placement.Base = FreeCAD.Vector(stock_x_min, stock_y_min, stock_z_min)
box_feature.Placement = placement

# Add the box feature to the stock body
stock_body.addObject(box_feature)
print(f"Added StockBox to Stock body")

# Recompute to ensure the stock is properly created
doc.recompute()

# Verify stock was created
stock_shape = stock_body.Shape
print(f"Stock shape type: {stock_shape.ShapeType}")
if hasattr(stock_shape, 'Solids') and len(stock_shape.Solids) > 0:
    solid_bbox = stock_shape.Solids[0].BoundBox
    print(f"Stock actual bounding box: ({solid_bbox.XMin}, {solid_bbox.YMin}, {solid_bbox.ZMin}) to ({solid_bbox.XMax}, {solid_bbox.YMax}, {solid_bbox.ZMax})")

# Now set up CAM operations
# First, check if Path workbench is available
try:
    import Path
    print("Path module imported successfully")
except ImportError as e:
    print(f"Could not import Path module: {e}")

# Try to activate Path workbench
try:
    FreeCADGui.activeDocument().setEditMode("Path")
    print("Set Path workbench mode")
except:
    pass

# Create a CAM Job
try:
    job = doc.addObject("Path::Job", "CAM_Job")
    job.Label = "Milling Job"
    print(f"Created CAM Job: {job.Name}")
    
    # Set the job's document
    job.Document = doc
    
    # Set the model (the part to machine)
    job.Model = [body]
    print(f"Set job model to Body")
    
    # Set the stock
    job.Stock = stock_body
    print(f"Set job stock to Stock")
    
    # Set up the machine controller
    try:
        controller = doc.addObject("Path::Controller", "MachineController")
        controller.Label = "GCode Controller"
        job.Controller = controller
        print("Created and set MachineController")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Could not create controller: {e}")
        # Try alternative approach
        try:
            controller = doc.addObject("PartDesign::FeaturePython", "Controller")
            job.Controller = controller
        except:
            pass
    
    # Set up the tool table
    try:
        tooltable = doc.addObject("Path::ToolTable", "ToolTable")
        tooltable.Label = "Tool Library"
        job.Tooltable = tooltable
        print("Created ToolTable")
        
        # Create a simple end mill tool
        tool = doc.addObject("Path::Tool", "EndMill_10mm")
        tool.Label = "10mm End Mill"
        tool.Type = "EndMill"
        tool.Diameter = 10.0
        tool.CuttingEdgeLength = 20.0
        tool.ShankDiameter = 6.0
        tool.NumberOfFlutes = 4
        tool.Material = "HSS"
        tooltable.addTool(tool)
        print("Created 10mm End Mill tool")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Could not create tool table: {e}")
    
    # Create a setup operation
    try:
        setup = doc.addObject("Path::OpPlain", "Setup")
        setup.Label = "Initial Setup"
        setup.Job = job
        setup.Base = FreeCAD.Vector(0, 0, 0)
        print("Created Setup operation")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Could not create setup: {e}")
    
    # Create a pocket operation for the base
    try:
        # This would typically use contours from the part
        pocket = doc.addObject("Path::OpPocketShape", "BasePocket")
        pocket.Label = "Base Pocketing"
        pocket.Job = job
        pocket.Base = body
        print("Created Pocket operation")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Could not create pocket: {e}")
    
    # Create a profiling operation for the cylinder
    try:
        profile = doc.addObject("Path::OpProfileShape", "CylinderProfile")
        profile.Label = "Cylinder Profiling"
        profile.Job = job
        profile.Base = body
        print("Created Profile operation")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Could not create profile: {e}")
    
    # Set safe heights
    try:
        job.SafeHeight = 50.0
        job.ClearanceHeight = 30.0
        job.RapidSpeed = 5000
        print("Set safe heights and speeds")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Could not set heights: {e}")
        
except Exception as e:
    print(f"Error creating CAM job: {e}")
    import traceback
    traceback.print_exc()

# Recompute the document
doc.recompute()

# Save the document
save_path = "/home/user/Unnamed.FCStd"
doc.saveAs(save_path)
print(f"\nDocument saved to: {save_path}")

# Verify the save
import os
if os.path.exists(save_path):
    size = os.path.getsize(save_path)
    print(f"File exists, size: {size} bytes")
else:
    print("ERROR: File was not saved!")

FreeCAD.closeDocument(doc.Name)
print("\nDone!")
ENDSCRIPT
